fact: The Swaziland Meteorological Service's Agrometeorological Unit issued Agromet Update No. 03 of the 2024/25 season on 4 November 2024 for 21-31 October 2024, carrying NDVI anomaly and Vegetation Health Index maps for the 3rd dekad of October 2024 sourced from FAO-GIEWS.
title: Eswatini Agromet Update, Issue No. 03, Season 2024/25
publisher: Swaziland Meteorological Service, Agrometeorological Unit, Ministry of Tourism and Environmental Affairs
